Contemporary Arabian Majlis

Doha, Qatar · Residential

A contemporary Majlis designed around formal hospitality, generous seating and a calm material palette. The layout keeps the traditional purpose of the space while giving it a cleaner and more modern interior character.

  • Spacious seating arrangement designed for group gatherings
  • Marble, wood and upholstered finishes used to create contrast
  • Layered ceiling and accent lighting to support the atmosphere
